title: The extension name '…' isn't an UpperCamelCase identifier.

title: Uncancelled instance of 'StreamSubscription'.
summary: Try invoking 'cancel' in the function in which the 'StreamSubscription' was created. Its category is errorProne, memoryLeaks. It is stable since Dart 2.0.

title: Unnecessary duplication of receiver.
summary: Try using a cascade to avoid the duplication. Its category is brevity, languageFeatureUsage, style. It is stable since Dart 2.0.

title: This cast will always throw an exception because the nullable local variable '…' is not assigned.

title: Don't cast a nullable value to a non-nullable type.
summary: Try adding a not-null assertion ('!') to make the type non-nullable. Its category is errorProne. It is stable since Dart 2.12.
message_templates: Don't cast a nullable value to a non-nullable type.
